visualCharacteristics.layout: Rotating slider of full-width slides; each slide has a large background image with overlaid title (h1-size), one-line description and 1-2 pill-shaped CTA buttons; arrow buttons on the right and bar/dot pagination below

contentPattern: One row per slide: cell 1 = slide image; cell 2 = heading, description paragraph, 1-2 CTA links (bold = primary button). Option 'light-text' (Carousel Hero (light-text)) switches slide text and arrows to white for darker photos; without it text inherits the default (dark) colour.
